Nina: Heads-up — RC1 hotfix cut in ~45m (2026-03-16 22:00 UTC). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/8192 needs 2x LGTM before cutoff. Currently 0/2, merge protection will block. Can we rotate reviewers quickly? :alarm_clock:
Ryan: I'm on-call but can take a look in ~10m. What’s the riskiest part?
Nina: small KV-cache metric rename + mem init guard. Low risk but want two reviewers for perf/regression checks. Rollback plan is the fallback if we miss 2x.
Jas: pinging @Alex @Sam for second eyes — I can do a basic perf smoke now :eyes:
Alex: on it, running perf smoke in staging. ETA ~8m.
Sam: reading the diff now. quick q — any DB/schema changes? don’t see migrations.
Jas: no DB changes, just runtime flag + default guard.
Merge-bot: PR #8192 — CI: all checks passed ✅. Approvals: 1/2 required. Merge blocked by branch protection (2 approvals).
Alex: LGTM after smoke. no regressions observed. :white_check_mark:
Nina: great — Jas, can you add your approval when ready so we reach 2/2?
Jas: LGTM. added a short comment about making the flag default false for 24h, but approve. :thumbsup:
Sam: also approving, but flagging we should watch pod restart rate and memory RSS over next hour.
Nina: ok we have 3 approvals noted. Hold off on merging until 2 min before cutoff — i'll give explicit merge go/no-go. Merge-bot: do not auto-merge until Nina approves.
Merge-bot: Acknowledged. Auto-merge disabled for PR #8192 as requested by @Nina.
Nina: Plan B note: if we somehow lose one approval or smoke shows regressions by cut, we postpone and run rollback checklist. Thanks team for quick eyes.
Ryan: If anything blocks oncall, ping me directly (DM).
Deploy-bot: Scheduled cutover at 2026-03-16T22:00:00Z. Monitoring enabled, alerts on memory/p95 latency.
Nina: I’ll post a final go/no-go 2 minutes before cut. Closing this thread for async updates; re-open if anything changes.
